reasons.persona_fit: Directly speaks to small business owner-operators in a calm, realistic voice, strictly honoring Bareni's boundaries without sales hype or unauthorized CTAs.
reasons.clarity: Very clean structure and plain explanations that make the workflow decision, scope limits, and human-in-the-loop controls obvious on a first read.
reasons.actionability: Provides a practical, highly grounded 3-question diagnostic test to determine if the workflow is ready for automation before building anything.
reasons.factual_grounding: Accurately acknowledges that OCR and scan handling are out of scope, adheres strictly to human-approval requirements, and makes no false claims.
